WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_length) AS avg_of_rating_avg_lengths,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_rating_avg_ratios
FROM per_rating;

assumptions.assumption: Each rating is weighted equally when averaging the per-rating averages; AVG ignores NULL lengths and ratios.
